packageRules.description: pytest-homeassistant-custom-component pins homeassistant, pytest and syrupy to exact versions, so bumping any of them on its own is an unresolvable dependency conflict rather than a test failure. Move the whole set in one PR.

Stay on one stable Home Assistant minor line (currently 2026.9): test against what users actually run, never a beta. pytest-homeassistant-custom-component is capped alongside it because it pins homeassistant exactly and starts targeting the next minor's betas before that minor is stable; 0.13.366 is the release pinning 2026.9.3. When a newer 2026.9.x patch ships, raise the phacc cap to the release pinning it. Move both caps to the next line together once its .0 is stable and a phacc pinning it exists.
